# dpl

**Tag**: devops

## 简介

Dpl (dee-pee-ell) is a tool made for continuous deployment, running deployments at Travis CI.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/travis-ci/dpl
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/dpl/2.0.5.4
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/travis-ci/dpl/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/dpl
